member.param: Menu name to add it to (null for default)
Id of this item, this can be path separated by /, ex: "Debug/Data/CompressionTable"
The display name of the item
The js code to execute, return true to close the menu on invocation
The title (tool tip) to display
A class name (maybe url supported later)
Optional sort order (items with same order values will be sorted by Name)
The auth required for this item to be available in the menu
If true, this menu item is only available if there is no user
Dynamically modify item, this is a type name followed by a . and then the method name to invoke
